name: telepathy
description: Telepathy for your coding agents: this Claude Code session can message Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI and other agent sessions on this machine, and their messages wake it. Adds three tools (list_peers, send_message, read_messages), a SessionStart hook that registers the session, hooks on ListAgents and SendMessage that add other agents' sessions to them, a background monitor that announces incoming messages, and UserPromptSubmit/Stop hooks for sessions where the monitor can't run: in the Claude app they have Claude start a one-shot background waiter that wakes the session when a message arrives, and they hand over waiting messages at the next turn. Everything stays on this machine in ~/.telepathy. It reads Claude Code's session-name files, Codex's session index, and the last turn marker of Codex session logs (for busy/idle status). No network calls, no telemetry.
